summary: A survey of trickster tales and parables from around the world, covering Brer Rabbit, Anansi, Reynard the Fox, Coyote, Puss in Boots and Kuma Lisa. Each trickster is paired with a short parable and a lesson, such as the folly of greed, pride or hoarding wisdom. The note concludes that these animal tricksters share the human experience of facing struggles with wit and seeing the powerful duped.
one_line: Overview of global trickster tales, from Brer Rabbit and Anansi to Reynard, Coyote, Puss in Boots and Kuma Lisa, and the lessons they teach.
key_facts: Brer Rabbit comes from African, Cherokee, and European folklore and entered American culture through Joel Chandler Harris's "Uncle Remus" stories, dated September 8, 2023 in the note.
In the Brer Rabbit tale, the cornered rabbit begs Brer Fox not to throw him into the briar patch; the fox does so, not realizing it is where the rabbit wants to be.
Anansi is the Ashanti spider trickster of West Africa, and a compilation of his tales was released in a best-selling children's book in Ghana on September 20, 2023.

Anansi tried to hoard all the world's wisdom in a pot; his son Ntikuma suggested tying it to his stomach instead of his back, Anansi dropped the pot, and wisdom scattered everywhere, teaching that wisdom is for sharing.
Reynard the Fox is a medieval European trickster whose stories were collected in a publication dated September 12, 2023, and they expose greed and corruption in high places.
Reynard convinced Bruin the bear that the best honey was in a carpenter's slit log; Bruin stuck his head in and was trapped.
Coyote appears in First Nations and Native American storytelling, and variations of his tales were celebrated at a cultural revival festival on September 15, 2023.
Coyote boasted he could dance with his eyes closed, the other animals moved the circle toward a cliff, and he danced over the edge, illustrating the perils of pride.
Puss in Boots is celebrated with statues and murals unveiled in European towns on September 23, 2023, and uses his wiles to raise his lowly master to nobility.
Puss claimed his master was the Marquis of Carabas and tricked an ogre into becoming a mouse, which he ate; the king visited the fields on September 29, 2023.
Kuma Lisa is a Bulgarian fox trickster whose tales were compiled in an anthology released on September 7, 2023, teaching that brains often trump brawn.
Kuma Lisa convinced a bear that the moon's reflection in water was cheese; the bear jumped in and nearly drowned while she ate the real cheese she had hidden.
